tiff_source_axis_values.interpretation: Loaded position/channel/time indices refer to these sorted source IDs; stacked TIFF time is its zero-based page index.

source_mapping: For directory TIFFs use the stored file map; for stacks use loader time index; otherwise use T/P/C indices in the source dataset.

transforms.registration_sampling: Output (y,x) samples cropped input (y-YShift,x-XShift), with nearest-edge padding.

segmentation.cell_ids: frame-specific segmentation labels; not tracked identities

processing.background_exclusion_rule: Union of selected raw-channel threshold masks and optional cell footprints, expanded by the margin
processing.background_sample_definition: Exactly three non-overlapping integer rectangles per frame/channel; x,y,width,height; upper bounds exclusive; sample finite original intensities before smoothing; subtract pooled mean
processing.background_sample_disagreement_rule: Warn if (max sample mean - min sample mean) / abs(pooled mean) exceeds 0.20; warning does not block confirmation

accepted_setup.triangle_background_sampling: finite pixels where saved cell labels equal zero

triangle_settings.block_triangle: rightmost significant peak, basin-restricted longer tail
triangle_settings.cell_triangle: tallest significant peak, forced left tail
triangle_settings.selection: lower arithmetic mean of nine midpoints; tie lower channel index
triangle_settings.interpolation: bilinear at actual block centers, constant edge extension
triangle_settings.background_sampling: finite pixels where saved cell labels equal zero
triangle_settings.cell_bin_range: all finite original pixels per channel/frame

settings.block_triangle: rightmost significant peak, basin-restricted longer tail
settings.cell_triangle: tallest significant peak, forced left tail
settings.selection: lower arithmetic mean of nine midpoints; tie lower channel index
settings.interpolation: bilinear at actual block centers, constant edge extension
settings.background_sampling: finite pixels where saved cell labels equal zero
settings.cell_bin_range: all finite original pixels per channel/frame

settings.selection: lower arithmetic mean of nine midpoints; tie lower channel index
settings.interpolation: bilinear at actual block centers, constant edge extension

settings.cell_bin_range: all finite original pixels per channel/frame

measurements.raw_intensity: ImageData.get() after crop/registration, before background correction, smoothing or uint8 conversion
measurements.corrected_intensity: Raw minus per-frame/channel pooled manual-sample mean (or legacy cell-free median); negative values retained
measurements.whole_cell: All finite fluorescence pixels in each cell footprint, independently of fluorescence threshold
measurements.positive_region: Cell label intersected with the final fluorescence-positive mask
measurements.nonfinite_values: Excluded; valid pixel counts and intensity statuses are exported
measurements.empty_positive_region: Mean and sum are zero to match existing overlap-based metrics; status explicitly marks empty regions
measurements.ratio: dead whole-cell mean divided by live whole-cell mean; nonpositive denominator or unavailable intensities yield null
measurements.overlap_fraction: Intersection divided by its named denominator; zero denominators yield null

mask_format.cell_labels: integer label array, zero background; IDs preserved
